name.title: Name
name.description: Native job name used to identify this monitor and its history. Renaming creates a separate monitor.

site_id.title: Site ID
site_id.description: Groups this job with other DEM jobs for the same site; leave empty to keep it unassigned. Use 1–64 lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

url.title: URL
url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL of the page to audit. Embedded credentials are not accepted.

save_report.title: Save HTML report
save_report.description: Save the full Lighthouse HTML report. Reports can contain sensitive URLs and page content.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Browser attempt timeout, in seconds. Waiting for another browser attempt is excluded.

site_id.ui:help: The ID does not replace the job name or require a RUM job. Retained runs and captures keep the association recorded when they were produced.
